size.value: 30x40mm (width 30mm x height 40mm). Also written as 3x4cm. JIS standard for resume (履歴書) and residence card (在留カード)

background.value: Plain background with no shadows. White is the most standard color; light blue and light grey also accepted for resumes. For residence card: plain without background shadows

head_height.value: 32-36mm from chin to top of head (for residence card 在留カード). For resume: approximately 30mm head portion with 2.5mm spacing from crown

validity.value: Within 3 months of submission (在留カード); within 3 months (resume convention)

expression_restriction.value: Neutral expression, facing forward directly (正面を向いたもの). No unfamiliar or exaggerated expressions

glasses_policy.value: Allowed if eyes are clearly visible. No thick frames covering eyes, no reflections on lenses

face_visibility.value: Full face visible, frontal view, no bangs obscuring eyes, no masks or cloth coverings (except religious/medical with documentation)

headwear_policy.value: No hat (無帽). Exception for religious or medical necessity with documentation, but face must not be obscured

is_white_background_allowed.value: Yes - white is the most standard and commonly used background color for Japanese ID/resume photos
